newsitem.title: USA: Morocco buys 49,500 T optional origin vegoil-trade.
newsitem.headline: Morocco buys 49,500 T optional origin vegoil-trade.

text.p: Morocco bought 49,500 tonnes optional origin vegoil -- soybean oil or rapeseed oil at seller's option -- for November/December arrival, U.S. exporters said.
The oil was acquired at $532.50 a tonne, FOB, several U.S. exporters said.
CBOT soyoil futures were up earlier in the session, partly spurred by market talk that China was seeking soybean oil.
But U.S. exporters could not confirm that China was tendering for several cargoes of optional origin soybean oil.
One exporter said if China was seeking crude degummed soybean oil, it would from South America, because that region offers the cheapest price, for likely shipment in the fourth quarter of this year.
